l.i: Te Domine semper appello, cujus omnia explo-
rans Justitia per humana quaecunque velamina,
Tu mihi cor dedisti ut haec subditis meis conce-

Fiat voluntas tua, nostrae quantumvis con-

page.notes: Bottom right number read as "194"; the last digit is doubtful and may be "184" or a damaged figure, so it is marked [?]. The long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Running head is Greek and rendered with Greek letters as printed.
